read.en: Sandisk has lost 8% in five sessions and closed below all four of its short and medium averages, with the 30 and 100-day both near $1,650–1,675. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and the gap is widening, RSI is 44, and Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 6. The stock is 33% off its June peak of $2,354, though still far above the 200-day average ($1,182).
read.zh: 闪迪五个交易日下跌 8%，收盘跌破全部四条中短期均线，30 日和 100 日均线均在 $1,650–1,675 附近。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且差距扩大，RSI 为 44，抛物线 SAR 于 10月6日转空。股价较6月高点 $2,354 回落 33%，但仍远高于 200 日均线（$1,182）。

read.en: The $1,470–1,505 zone is the line to watch: it is the 20-day low and a level that held five times since June. Holding it keeps the stock in a sideways range; a close below it targets $1,300, the July low. On the upside, sellers have defended $1,650–1,675 (the 30 and 100-day averages) and $1,853, which capped five rallies in September.
read.zh: 需关注 $1,470–1,505 区域：这是 20 日低点，也是6月以来五次守住的位置。守住则维持横盘；收盘跌破则下看 $1,300（7月低点）。上方，卖方在 $1,650–1,675（30 日与 100 日均线）及 $1,853（9月五次反弹受阻处）设防。
